title: NASA’s Swift Telescope Ends Its Long Mission
paragraphs: NASA has a space telescope called Swift. It looks for gamma-ray bursts. These are very big flashes of light in space.
Swift went into space in 2004. It was a two-year mission, but Swift worked for almost 22 years. Its last observation was on October 20.
Now Swift is too low. The air near Earth slows it down. Soon it will fall back to Earth. Swift gave scientists a lot of good data.

questions.q: When did Swift go into space?
Why does Swift stop its work?
questions.a: It is too low and the air slows it down.
